review_title: Tricyclic drugs for depression in children and adolescents
screening_criteria: Randomised controlled trials comparing the efficacy of orally administered tricyclic drugs with placebo in depressed people aged 6 to 18 years.
gold_label_policy_description: dataset label 1.0 counts as INCLUDE; 0.5 and 0.0 count as EXCLUDE

studies.study_title: Pulse intravenous clomipramine for depressed adolescents: double‐blind, controlled trial
studies.predicted_reason: Randomized controlled trial but uses intravenous clomipramine, not orally administered as required.

studies.study_title: A double‐blind, randomized, placebo‐controlled trial of fluoxetine in children and adolescents with depression
studies.predicted_reason: Randomized controlled trial but evaluates fluoxetine (an SSRI), not a tricyclic drug.

studies.study_title: Double‐blind placebo‐controlled study of nortriptyline in depressed adolescents using a "fixed plasma level" design
studies.predicted_reason: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of oral nortriptyline (tricyclic antidepressant) in depressed adolescents aged 12-17 years.

studies.study_title: Childhood and adolescent depression: a review of the past 10 years. Part I
studies.predicted_reason: Literature review, not a randomized controlled trial.

studies.study_title: Imipramine treatment of depressed children: a double‐blind pilot study
studies.predicted_reason: Double-blind pilot study of oral imipramine (tricyclic) vs placebo in depressed children. Use of child-specific depression scales (BID, SADLI, CDI) indicates pediatric sample likely within 6-18 years age range.

studies.study_title: Amitriptyline in children with major depressive disorder: a double‐blind crossover pilot study
studies.predicted_reason: Double-blind crossover pilot study of oral amitriptyline (tricyclic) vs placebo in children with MDD aged 9-12 years.

studies.study_title: Newer generation antidepressants for depressive disorders in children and adolescents
studies.predicted_reason: Focuses on newer generation antidepressants (SSRIs), not tricyclic drugs; appears to be a review/protocol, not an RCT reporting tricyclic vs placebo comparison.

studies.study_title: Imipramine plus cognitive‐behavioural therapy in the treatment of school refusal
studies.predicted_reason: Randomized, double-blind trial comparing imipramine (tricyclic) + CBT vs placebo + CBT in adolescents with school refusal and comorbid anxiety/depression. CBT is constant across groups, so this tests the efficacy of adding imipramine to CBT.

studies.study_title: Imipramine in prepubertal major depressive disorders
studies.predicted_reason: Five-week, double-blind, placebo-controlled study of oral imipramine (tricyclic) vs placebo in prepubertal children with major depressive disorder (age range implied as 6-12 years).

studies.study_title: Efficacy of paroxetine treatment in the treatment of adolescent depression: a randomized, controlled trial
studies.predicted_reason: Randomized controlled trial with three arms: paroxetine, imipramine (tricyclic), and placebo. Reports imipramine vs placebo comparison for adolescents with major depression.

studies.study_title: Mechanism of action of antidepressant medications
studies.predicted_reason: Review article discussing antidepressant mechanisms, not a randomized controlled trial.

studies.study_title: SSRI safety in overdose
studies.predicted_reason: Focuses on overdose safety profiles of SSRIs vs TCAs, not an efficacy RCT comparing tricyclic drug to placebo.

studies.study_title: Measuring inconsistency in meta‐analyses
studies.predicted_reason: Discusses statistical methods for meta-analysis, not an RCT of tricyclic antidepressants.

studies.study_title: Clinical, electrocardiographic, and laboratory findings in children with amitriptyline intoxication
studies.predicted_reason: Studies clinical findings in amitriptyline poisoning/intoxication, not an efficacy RCT of antidepressant treatment.

studies.study_title: The effect of concomitant disorders in childhood depression on predicting treatment response
studies.predicted_reason: Secondary analysis predicting treatment response based on concomitant disorders; does not specify the drug is tricyclic and is not a primary RCT report.

studies.study_title: Adolescent depression: controlled desipramine treatment and atypical features
studies.predicted_reason: Randomized controlled trial of oral desipramine (tricyclic) vs placebo in adolescents (ages 13-18) with major depression.

studies.study_title: Psychopharmacology of child and adolescent major depression: present status and future directions
studies.predicted_reason: Review article describing current status and future directions, not a randomized controlled trial.

studies.study_title: Comparative studies of pharmacotherapy for school refusal
studies.predicted_reason: Includes a double-blind, placebo-controlled study comparing imipramine (tricyclic) to placebo (along with alprazolam) in adolescents with school refusal and comorbid anxiety/depression.

studies.study_title: Selected tricyclic antidepressant ingestions involving children 6 years old or less
studies.predicted_reason: Studies accidental ingestions/poisoning of tricyclic antidepressants, not an efficacy RCT.

studies.study_title: A randomized, controlled trial of amitriptyline in the acute treatment of adolescent major depression
studies.predicted_reason: Randomized, controlled trial of oral amitriptyline (tricyclic) vs placebo in adolescents aged 12-17 years with major depressive disorder.

studies.study_title: School phobia: a therapeutic trial with clomipramine and short‐term outcome
studies.predicted_reason: Double-blind trial of oral clomipramine (tricyclic) vs placebo (both with psychotherapy) in children with school refusal and neurotic disorder (which includes depression). School phobia context suggests school-aged children within 6-18 years.

studies.study_title: Meta‐analysis of early phase II studies with paroxetine in hospitalised depressed patients
studies.predicted_reason: Meta-analysis of studies involving patients aged 18-65 years (outside 6-18 range); compares paroxetine to amitriptyline but is not a primary RCT.

studies.study_title: Depression in children: relationship between plasma imipramine levels and response
studies.predicted_reason: Studies imipramine treatment and plasma level correlations but lacks a placebo control group; compares high vs low plasma levels, not drug vs placebo.

studies.study_title: Randomized, controlled trial of amitriptyline versus placebo for adolescents with "treatment‐resistant" major depression
studies.predicted_reason: Randomized, controlled trial of oral amitriptyline (tricyclic) vs placebo in adolescents with treatment-resistant major depressive disorder.

studies.study_title: Imipramine compliance in adolescents
studies.predicted_reason: Eight-week double-blind study of imipramine (tricyclic) vs placebo, both combined with cognitive-behavioral therapy for school refusal, in anxious-depressed adolescents. Tests compliance but includes the efficacy comparison.
